ideas.pitch: A localized environmental monitoring dashboard using satellite and IoT sensor data to track building-level energy usage and green cover changes across the Clemson campus.
ideas.title: Clemson Campus Footprint AI Carbon & Energy Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the pattern from GeoNex-ATLAS by applying geospatial and satellite monitoring to a hyper-local, recognizable environment like the host university campus, appealing directly to sustainability-minded judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and campus dining optimization platform that generates personalized meal plans based on student schedules, dietary restrictions, and actual dining hall menus.
ideas.title: Clemson Student Wellness & Meal Planner AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the proven formula of the E-Foodiee AI Nutrition Assistant to solve an immediate, relatable problem for students attending the university where the hackathon is hosted.

ideas.pitch: An automated risk detection and incident forecasting platform for university research grants, utilizing Poisson regression and machine learning models to flag compliance anomalies early.
ideas.title: Clemson Research Grant Compliance & Risk Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the rigorous statistical forecasting seen in the AI incident forecasting winner with real institutional use cases that university administrators and judges value.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized micro-task marketplace where student organizations can post project needs and reward contributors using secure escrow smart contracts.
ideas.title: Clemson Student Club Autonomous Task & Escrow Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the autonomous marketplace structure of Dispatch while tailoring the workflow specifically to student club operations and campus engagement.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight, no-code algorithmic trading strategy builder designed for collegiate finance clubs to test and simulate crypto or stock strategies instantly.
ideas.title: TigerTrading No-Code Strategy Backtester
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the successful no-code architecture of ClashX while focusing on educational and local collegiate financial club engagement.
